Hi Mina / Marcus,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. We're ready to schedule the BYO-KMS (HSM) handover for our Redwood Private deployment in our us-west-2 VPC. Before we lock dates, security asked for a short preflight to confirm networking, IP allowlists, and ceremony windows so we can staff on our side.

Attaching our internal checklist — would you confirm the items we should expect Redwood to own versus what Acme must provide? In particular:
- IP ranges that need to be allowed inbound to the HSM gateway and operator bastion
- Ports/protocols for KMS/HSM control plane and attestation (TCP/UDP)
- Expected maintenance/cutover windows and timeline for secret sealing/unsealing
- Telemetry endpoints that will be allowed (metrics/traces) and required cert fingerprints

High level timeline we'd like: preflight checks this week, dry-run ceremony next week, production cutover the following week.

If you prefer, we can do a 30-min preflight call Wed 10:00 PT.

Alice — thanks for the clear list. I pulled together a short Redwood preflight we run for BYO-HSM handoffs; attaching our version (acme-byok-preflight-checklist.pdf). Key notes up-front:

- Ownership: Redwood will operate the inference control-plane egress and the KMS agent that contacts the HSM gateway. Acme controls the HSM appliance, physical custody, and the operator bastion that initiates pin ceremonies.
- IP allowlist: Redwood will provide a set of egress IPs for the control-plane and for ephemeral operator sessions. We need your VPC team to allow these outbound to your HSM gateway on the ports below.
- Ports: TLS (443) for certificate-based attestation and a dedicated management port (TCP 15001) for RPC/control traffic. We also recommend an internal-only NTP (UDP 123) and time drift checks during ceremonies.
- Metrics: TLS-secured Prometheus scrape endpoint only reachable from a monitoring subnet; optional pushgateway if you cannot open inbound.
- Cutover rhythm: dry-run (no production keys) -> ceremony rehearsal (test keys) -> production handover. Each step needs a 1-hr window; allow 2 hrs for the production ceremony to account for rollbacks.

I'm available Wed 10:00 PT for a preflight call. Marcus and Jonas will cover network/firewall specifics; Tessa will own runbook updates and ticketing.

Mina Haddad
Head of Private Deployments, Redwood Inference

Attachments: acme-byok-preflight-checklist.pdf

Quick network callouts from my side after skimming Acme's diagram: (see acme-vpc-network-diagram-v3.png)

- Egress IPs: We'll supply the exact CIDRs before the dry-run. Please confirm your firewall can add 3 ephemeral /28 ranges (control-plane, operator-bastion, monitoring).
- NAT & Hairpinning: If you run restricted NAT, ensure the operator bastion can reach the HSM gateway via its private IPs; hairpin NAT can cause session failures during the pin ceremony.
- MTU: Some HSMs use jumbo frames for bulk key transfer; confirm MTU >= 1500 across the path.
- DNS & Certificate pinning: You'll need to accept our intermediate cert thumbprint for attestation; we recommend short-lived cert rotation aligned to your CA schedule.

Also: during the rehearsal please ensure the HSM admin account used for the ceremony has console access for emergency zeroize — we will not perform that action but need confirmation it's available.

I'll join the Wed 10:00 PT call; propose we allocate the first 15 minutes to network ACLs and the remaining 15 to the ceremony script.

Marcus Lin
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
